topic: SBIC East/Central/West ChatGPT references, Kamilah Stevenson channel identity gate, and source-PR overlap reconciliation for PR #1660

sbic.conclusion: Tokyo (East), Nagoya (Central), and Osaka (West) are three separate Japanese statutory companies under the Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Companies Act, distinct from SBI Holdings, Inc.

primary_event_sources.entity: SBIC East / Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
primary_event_sources.subject: Generative AI / ChatGPT: current state and future
primary_event_sources.finding: Tokyo SBIC hosted a ChatGPT-focused educational seminar; Microsoft Japan executive presented and demonstrated use cases. No OpenAI partnership or procurement disclosed.

primary_event_sources.entity: SBIC East / Tokyo Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
primary_event_sources.subject: Generative AI and machine-learning introductory training
primary_event_sources.finding: Investee-company training included ChatGPT use, Copilot, RAG and API implementation. Educational use only.

primary_event_sources.entity: SBIC West / Osaka Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
primary_event_sources.subject: Generative AI introductory seminar for accounting firms and support organizations
primary_event_sources.finding: Official SBIC West publication advertises a ChatGPT-focused generative-AI seminar. Educational event only; no OpenAI commercial relationship disclosed.

primary_event_sources.entity: SBIC Central / Nagoya Small and Medium Business Investment & Consultation Co., Ltd.
primary_event_sources.subject: Investee-company generative-AI roundtable
primary_event_sources.finding: Generative-AI experience sharing and practical-use discussion; the page does not name ChatGPT or OpenAI.

sbic.interpretation: Public primary sources establish regional educational activity around ChatGPT/generative AI at Tokyo and Osaka SBIC, and a generative-AI roundtable at Nagoya SBIC. They do not establish an OpenAI partnership, a shared SBIC procurement, SBI Holdings involvement, or an XRP relationship.
sbic.source_independence: The three companies are legally distinct but share a statutory framework; each event page is primary evidence for its own event. Do not treat them as three independent confirmations of a commercial partnership.

Kamilah Stevenson YouTube.person_identity: not used to infer channel ownership
Kamilah Stevenson YouTube.discovery: Third-party directories surfaced multiple same-name channels and conflicting subscriber snapshots (including approximately 143K and 138K for a similarly branded channel), plus several small similarly named channels.
Kamilah Stevenson YouTube.cross_link: A third-party Telegram bio points to a YouTube handle with a trailing 'a'; no reciprocal first-party link or verified ownership chain was found.
Kamilah Stevenson YouTube.action: Do not attribute videos to the person until a first-party website/social profile or verified channel cross-link confirms ownership.
